title: One line for SECURITY.md section e, from the first handover
summary: incident.identity@: one line for SECURITY.md section e, from the first handover: `sgit vault show-key` prints the key only when run inside the vault folder (`cd <vault> && sgit vault show-key .`; with a path argument from elsewhere it printed nothing here); take the 'Vault key:' field into VAULT_KEY through the environment, never the command line or the screen, then `node tools/lane-handover.mjs seal --via-lane`.
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
